title: Pure Timelord
summary: Timelord cards only, with generic Rank 10s, Links and staples. Timelords are Level 10 Fairies with 0 ATK that Normal Summon without tributing onto an empty field. They can't be destroyed and you take no battle damage from them. Each one fires a big effect at the end of a Battle Phase in which it battled, then shuffles itself back into the Deck in your next Standby Phase. Michion halves their LP, Kamion spins a card, and Zaphion clears their Spells and Traps. Time Maiden summons itself onto an empty field, counts as two tributes, and tributes itself to search a 0-ATK Timelord. The three Continuous Traps form a chain: Empty Machine Sets Infinite Machine, which summons a Timelord from the hand and Sets Infinite Light. Infinite Light summons one Timelord each from the hand, Deck and GY whenever you control no monsters. Timelord Progenitor Vorpgate is left out: it needs a Tuner, and no Tuner plus a Level 10 Timelord adds up to Level 10.
